plan: This is the first round, so there's no history to learn from. The optimal strategy in a second-price auction with rational bidders is to bid your true value. This prevents you from losing money by bidding above your value and maximizes your chances of winning when it's profitable. I will bid my value of $31.

The optimal strategy in a second-price auction with N bidders is to bid your true value. This is a dominant strategy, meaning it's the best strategy regardless of what other bidders do.
